order: ORDER AS ISSUED (the intent, spelled out) Carry the in-progress rename of the plan roundabout from "ultra-plan" to "deep-plan" out of the working tree into this commit, complete and self-consistent across the harness: - Rename `hooks/orchestra-ultraplan.js` to `hooks/orchestra-deepplan.js` and convert everything it carries: the file header and usage text, the `ORCHESTRA_ULTRAPLAN_*` environment-variable names (MODEL, EFFORT, TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_TOKENS), the `ULTRA-PLAN ENGINE` header line, the `ULTRAPLAN_UNAVAILABLE` verdict token, the saved-response temp-directory prefix, and every prose mention. - Rename `skills/ultra-plan/` to `skills/deep-plan/` and update the skill's frontmatter `name` and `description`, its headings, the runner path it names for dormant/paused sessions, its env-var references, its UNAVAILABLE verdict token, and the plan-file log heading it appends. - Point `install.js` at the new runner filename: the runner constant, the install-time copy and its progress line, and the uninstall removal list. - Update `agents/planner-gpt.md`: the frontmatter description, the prose, the `node ...` invocation, the UNAVAILABLE token it relays, and the configuration list. - Update `ORCHESTRA.md`: the `planner-gpt` roster row and the bundled-skills paragraph. - Update `README.md` end to end: the repository tree, the installer step list, the slash-command paragraph, the bundled-skills table row, the stamped-wholesale note, the roundabout section and its heading, the env-var table, the cost section, and the troubleshooting row. - Update the bundled-skill roster in `skills/orchestra-status/SKILL.md` so the `/orchestra-status` report names `deep-plan` as a bundled skill rather than the old name. Leave all other behavior unchanged — this is a rename plus its documentation sync, nothing else.
